intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Kabuto/Black Kabuto sniper, multiple Pop Greens with distinct documented behavior, traps and Observation awakening. Long-range precision and plant lane control. No invented continuous Haki mastery, free flying, or magical damage aura. Named plants must correspond to implemented behavior. Sogeking is a persona, not a supernatural transformation. Supplemental research focus: Focus fresh source extraction on canonical named Pop Greens and their distinct effects, explicitly separating Film-only plants and post-Wano appearances from manga techniques established through Wano. Verify Black Kabuto and Growth behavior. Retain claims only when supported by read source content; label missing facts as gaps. Do not infer game mechanics or numbers from canon. Final evidence coverage: Read individual named Pop Green effects and Kuro Kabuto/Grow Up/Bakun So equipment behavior plus Observation Haki awakening. Decide manga-through-Wano eligibility from source evidence and described usage, not memory or blanket exclusions. Nemuri So, Hanabibana and Baku Bokkuri have Wano source descriptions and must not be discarded merely as Film-only. Separate actually adaptation-only, Film-only, game-only, and post-Wano entries. Observation awakening must not imply continuous Haki mastery. Report missing facts as gaps.
